title: shy3130/tickflow-stock-panel
claim: shy3130/tickflow-stock-panel — A self-hosted, zero-ops quant workbench for China A-shares: screening, monitoring and backtesting with an LLM co-pilot.
hook: A self-hosted quant desk for China A-shares — screen, backtest and monitor stocks with an LLM co-pilot, zero ops.
why_good: Retail quant tooling for A-shares is mostly clunky or paywalled; this packages screening, backtesting and LLM-driven analysis into a zero-ops self-host stack (DuckDB/Polars/FastAPI) — a clear wedge into China's massive retail-investor base.
value: A hosted edition plus premium data connectors and strategy packs for retail A-share traders and small funds who want their own quant desk without a Bloomberg budget.
risk: It leans on a third-party data source (TickFlow) it does not control, and financial tooling invites data-licensing and regulatory headaches; the moat is the workflow, not the data.

zh.claim: shy3130/tickflow-stock-panel —— 自托管、零运维的 A 股量化工作台:选股、监控、回测,配 LLM 副驾。
zh.hook: 自托管的 A 股量化工作台——选股、回测、盯盘,配一个 LLM 副驾,零运维。
zh.why_good: 面向散户的 A 股量化工具大多要么难用、要么付费墙;它把选股、回测和 LLM 驱动的分析打包成零运维的自托管栈(DuckDB/Polars/FastAPI)——一个切入中国庞大散户群体的清晰楔子。
zh.value: 向散户 A 股交易者和小型基金卖托管版 + 高级数据接口和策略包——他们想要自己的量化台,又没有彭博的预算。
zh.risk: 它依赖一个自己不掌控的第三方数据源(TickFlow),金融工具还会招来数据授权与监管麻烦;护城河是工作流,不是数据。
